description:
Google Sheets API - Create spreadsheets, add data, format cells, analyze data. V2 includes SMART BUNDLED TOOLS for efficient operations.

⚠️ CRITICAL: ALL tools in this platform MUST be called through the execute_tool meta-tool for proper OAuth credential injection. DO NOT call these tools directly. Always use: execute_tool(tool_name='toolname', ...parameters)

tools.name: gsheets_create_complete_spreadsheet
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) ALWAYS execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER reference 'I created earlier' or use conversation history
(2) MUST return format: **[Name]** | ID: `[id]` | URL: [full_url] | Link: [title](url)
(3) Use EXACT values from tool response - NEVER make up fake URLs/IDs
(4) If tool fails, say 'Failed to create' - NEVER pretend it succeeded

Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='gsheets_create_complete_spreadsheet', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

⭐ PREFERRED METHOD ✨ SUPPORTS MARKDOWN: Create a complete spreadsheet with data and formatting in ONE operation. Much more efficient than calling create + write + format separately. Spreadsheet is automatically shareable.

🎨 MARKDOWN FORMATTING (set parse_markdown=True):
  • **bold** → Bold text
  • *italic* → Italic text
  • # Header → Bold, 18pt font, gray background
  • [RED]text[/RED] → Red text (errors, critical)
  • [GREEN]text[/GREEN] → Green text (success, active)
  • [BLUE]text[/BLUE] → Blue text (info)
  • [YELLOW]text[/YELLOW] → Yellow text (warning, pending)
  • [ORANGE], [PURPLE], [GRAY] → Also supported
  • Auto-borders on all cells

USE THIS when you need colored, formatted dashboards or reports.

data.description: 2D array of data [[row1], [row2], ...]. Each row is an array of values.

headers.description: Optional header row (will be bolded and frozen automatically)

formatting.description: Optional formatting options: bold_headers (bool), freeze_header (bool), auto_resize (bool)

shareable.description: Make spreadsheet accessible to anyone with the link

parse_markdown.description: 🎨 ENABLE MARKDOWN FORMATTING: Set to true to parse markdown syntax (**bold**, *italic*, #headers, [RED]colored text[/RED], etc.) and apply professional formatting. Default: false (plain text only)

returns.description: Complete spreadsheet details with id, url (shareable link), title, rows_added, columns count

tools.usage_notes: This is the MOST EFFICIENT way to create spreadsheets. Use this instead of separate create + write + format calls. Headers are automatically bolded and frozen.

tools.name: gsheets_ai_generate_table
tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) Execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER use cached/remembered data from conversation history
(2) MUST cite resource: 'Read X from **[Resource Name]** (ID: `[id]` | URL: [url])'
(3) Use EXACT [id] provided - NEVER substitute with different ID

Example response:
Read 45 rows from **Sales Spreadsheet**
- ID: `xyz789`
- URL: https://example.com/sheet/xyz789
- Data: [actual data read]

⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='gsheets_ai_generate_table', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

Example response:
Read 45 rows from **Sales Spreadsheet**
- ID: `xyz789`
- URL: https://example.com/sheet/xyz789
- Data: [actual data read]

⭐ AI-POWERED ⚠️ NO MARKDOWN: Generate a data table from natural language description. AI determines appropriate columns, generates realistic sample data, and formats professionally. Perfect when you're not sure what structure to use.

NOTE: This tool does NOT support markdown formatting. Output is plain text only.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the table you want to create
prompt.example: Create a sales tracking table with columns for date, product name, quantity sold, unit price, and total revenue. Include 10 sample rows of realistic data.

title.description: Spreadsheet title (optional, AI will generate if not provided)

shareable.description: Make spreadsheet accessible to anyone with the link

returns.description: Complete spreadsheet with url (link to share), rows_generated count, and AI generation details

tools.usage_notes: Use this when the user describes what they want in natural language. AI will determine the best columns and generate realistic data. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

creating_spreadsheets.preferred_method: Use gsheets_create_complete_spreadsheet - it creates the spreadsheet with data and formatting in ONE call
creating_spreadsheets.ai_method: Use gsheets_ai_generate_table when the user describes what they want in natural language
creating_spreadsheets.bulk_method: Use gsheets_bulk_create_multiple when creating 2+ spreadsheets at once

best_practices: Always use smart bundled tools (gsheets_create_complete_spreadsheet) instead of create + write + format separately
Spreadsheets are shareable by default - no need to set permissions manually
Use AI generation when user provides a description rather than specific data structure
Use bulk operations when working with multiple spreadsheets
Headers are automatically bolded and frozen when using create_complete_spreadsheet

common_workflows.update_data: gsheets_write or gsheets_append to modify existing spreadsheet
